headline: European quantum is moving from research to industrial scale-up, with IQM carrying a €102.5M order backlog and €79M of EuroHPC quantum calls closing on 17 November, while the EU Quantum Act proposal is still pending (reported as expected on 18 November 2026).

signals.title: Xanadu names Bluefors as cryogenics partner
signals.detail: Xanadu's Q3 2026 results list a partnership with Bluefors to develop compact, modular cryogenics that bring detector cooling into a data-centre footprint. No contract value given.

signals.title: OtaNano promoted as open quantum facility for companies; Finnish 2035 targets restated
signals.detail: Article on Aalto-hosted OtaNano opening facilities to companies. Restates national 2035 targets: €3bn quantum-sector turnover, €400M private investment, 10,000 jobs; InstituteQ aims for 50 end-user companies by 2030. Finnish Quantum Flagship spin-outs named: A-Gate Sensors, Arctic Instruments, QMill. Promotional piece, no access terms given.

signals.title: Quantum Act status still unconfirmed
signals.detail: The act was planned for Q2 2026. Searches found only the consultation (Oct 2025) and legislative-train entry, with no confirmation of a formal proposal.

signals.title: IQM Q3 2026 primary filing confirms figures
signals.detail: SEC filing: Q3 revenue €8.86M, Jan-Sep revenue €17.73M (+49%), Q3 operating loss €171.2M including a €127.1M non-cash share listing expense, new orders €42.2M, backlog €102.5M, cash €260.4M, 31 systems sold and 17 delivered. FY2026 guidance of €42-47M revenue implies about €24-29M in Q4 alone.

signals.title: IQM reports Q3 2026 results
signals.detail: Revenue about €8.9M (+51%), new orders €42.2M, backlog €102.5M, cash €260.4M. FY2026 guidance reaffirmed: revenue €42-47M, order intake €65-75M, weighted to Q4. A €127M non-cash listing charge is included in the reported result.

signals.title: IQM Q3 2026 results due today
signals.detail: Date moved from 3 Nov to 5 Nov. Figures were not available at the time of this update.

signals.title: Quint Computing (FAU Erlangen spin-out) raises €9.1M first round
signals.detail: Led by Vsquared with Quantonation, Nucleus Capital and others; Aalto professor and IQM/QMill founder Mikko Möttönen is an angel investor. Company also holds a €2.2M EIC Pathfinder grant. Builds error-suppressing superconducting chips. A useful benchmark for a university hardware spin-out's first round.

signals.title: QuantrolOx raises €12M Series A
signals.detail: Anglo-Finnish Oxford spinout, led by IW Capital with the EIC Fund and Transpose Capital. Qubit control software.

signals.title: Coherence Quantum (Espoo) raises €2.78M seed
signals.detail: Led by Lifeline Ventures. Cryogenic signalling and control for scaling quantum computers; the money funds an Espoo lab and first prototypes. The firm is a likely partner for Aalto cryogenic-electronics work, but I did not verify its Aalto link.

signals.title: EU Quantum Act proposal reported as expected on 18 November 2026
signals.detail: Law-firm briefing says the Commission is expected to present the Quantum Act on 18 November 2026 (slipped from Q2 2026). Expected pillars: research and innovation, industrial capacity and investment, supply-chain protection; strategic projects, pilot manufacturing facilities, simpler licensing. Date is not confirmed by the Commission.

signals.title: Pasqal-led €50M Q-PLANET pilot line enters execution, VTT among partners
signals.detail: Three-year Chips JU pilot line for neutral-atom quantum chips, 28 partners from 11 member states including VTT. Shows EU pilot-line money reaching Finnish research organisations.

signals.title: VTT appoints Jani Kivioja to lead Quantum Technologies
signals.detail: Took over as Vice President of VTT's quantum research area on 1 November 2026, with a brief to link research to piloting and commercial applications.

signals.title: Bluefors and Verda become Finnish unicorns
signals.detail: Dealroom lists Bluefors (cryogenics) among September 2026 new unicorns (exact day not given); Algorithmiq raised a €18M Series B in May 2026.
